author: team
reason: removed the "guess instead of asking" and "always send immediately" instructions from v0; added explicit rules to call clarify on missing info, confirm before send, refuse out-of-scope requests without a tool call, and keep query args unpadded
hypothesis: v0 prompt tells the model to guess missing details and auto-send without confirmation
metric_name: causing missing_info/wrong_boundary/out_of_scope failures; removing those instructions and adding explicit clarify/refuse rules should fix routing

author: team
reason: clarify tool description was vague ("Gui mot cau hoi cho nguoi dung") and response_type was optional with a default, so the model omitted it; rewrote description to explain when to use yes_no/choice/text and moved response_type into required
hypothesis: remaining wrong_arg_value failures on clarify calls (R10/R11) are caused by the model omitting response_type because the schema does not require it; making it required plus adding usage guidance should make the model always set it explicitly

author: team
reason: added a sentence stating the send-confirmation rule takes priority over asking for other missing details (e.g. content), so ambiguous send requests like "dang ban tin nay" get response_type=yes_no instead of text
hypothesis: making the confirm-before-send rule explicitly outrank the missing-info rule in the prompt will make the model ask yes_no confirmation first even when content is also unclear

author: team
reason: v3's plain-prose priority rule was not strong enough to override the model's tendency to ask for missing content first; added an explicit worked example in system_prompt.md for this exact ambiguous send scenario, and reinforced the same rule directly in the clarify tool description in tools.yaml (response_type is ALWAYS yes_no as the first call for send/publish requests, regardless of missing content)
hypothesis: a concrete few-shot example plus reinforcing the rule at the tool-declaration level (not just system prompt) will make the model reliably choose yes_no over text for ambiguous send requests

author: team
reason: G09 (group suite) failed because fetch and paper_text both had one-line starter descriptions ('Lấy nội dung từ một địa chỉ.' / 'Lấy nội dung text của một bài báo.') with no boundary between them, so the model chose paper_text for an arxiv.org URL instead of the generic fetch the case expected. Rewrote both descriptions: fetch is now the default for 'read/summarize this link' even for arXiv URLs, paper_text is reserved for explicit full-PDF-extraction requests
hypothesis: clarifying the fetch vs paper_text boundary in tools.yaml (not touching system_prompt.md) should fix G09 without regressing the base suite (which never called paper_text on a plain link)
